chunks.title: Q2 Analyze a Problem & Propose a Solution (10 points) — Set 2: Serengeti & resource partitioning
chunks.content: AP Environmental Science FRQ 2, 'Analyze an Environmental Problem and Propose a Solution,' 10 points, one per lettered part (A–J), same task template as Set 1 (data figure, propose-and-justify a solution, content items). Set 2 topic: Serengeti ecosystem. Answer key highlights: A [P1] identify the plate-boundary type from Figure 1; B [P2] dominant biome within the Serengeti (savanna/tropical grassland); C [P3] wildebeest give birth as new grasses grow — reasoning about timing/resource availability; D [P4] explain why resource partitioning allows wildebeest and another grazer to coexist (they use different resources/niches, reducing competition). Later parts continue the identify/describe/explain and propose-a-solution pattern. Common failure: defining resource partitioning without linking it to reduced competition/coexistence; misidentifying the biome.

chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2A, 10/10
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 10/10 — earned all ten parts across the plate-boundary and biome identifications, the wildebeest-timing reasoning, the resource-partitioning explanation, and the propose-and-justify and content items. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Environmental Science
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 6/10
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 6/10 — typically earned the identifications and a proposed solution plus a couple of content items, while losing the harder explain/justify points (e.g., a resource-partitioning explanation that omits reduced competition). Illustrates the identify-and-propose points secured but explanation points missed.

chunks.subject: AP Environmental Science
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 2/10
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 2/10 — earned only about two points, generally the direct identifications, while losing the reasoning, explanation, and propose-and-justify points. Illustrates a low response that names features but cannot analyze the problem or propose/justify a solution.
